g.text: Private messaging from your desktop. Signal Desktop links with
Signal on Android or iOS and keeps your conversations end-to-end
Avoid hides this app from everyone who trusts your file.
Needs a phone number and a Signal account; the desktop app
can’t be used on its own.
Crash reports go to a hosted endpoint by default.
avoid until linking works without a phone.
Commit 4e1c9a2 isn’t signed, so it wasn’t pushed.
Your trust file must be signed by one of its authorities.
Saved to AppKata.md and committed locally.
